title: Best Cover Letter Writers (2026): Letters Tailored to the Job
description: How to hire a cover letter writer: tailoring to each job, what to send, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: Cover letter writers help you explain why you fit a specific job, in a clear and personal way. A strong letter connects your experience to what the employer needs. Problems start when letters are generic, invent achievements, or sound nothing like you. This guide helps you get a cover letter that supports your application honestly.

faq.q: Do I need a new letter for every job?
faq.a: Ideally, yes. A good approach is a strong base letter you adjust for each role. Some writers include a template for this.

faq.q: What should I send the writer?
faq.a: Your resume, the job description and a few notes on why you want the role and what you are proud of.
Share examples of your writing or a short voice note. Read the draft aloud and ask for changes if it does not sound like you.

faq.q: How long should a cover letter be?
faq.a: Usually one page or less. Hiring managers read quickly, so shorter and specific is better.

faq.q: Is it acceptable to use a writer?
faq.a: Yes, as long as everything in the letter is true and you can talk about it in an interview.
